data.verbatim: wait before the avatar after 2:55 "half the time"  is odd. the head movmenets and the hand movemenet dont match up to the conversation and the lip syncing is a bit off
data.interpretation: Reopens the locked S10 part C: movement does not match the conversation and lip sync is slightly off. Parts A and B lock unaffected.

data.method: Mouth-region openness and motion versus narration envelope, lags -10..+10 frames, for part A, part C (native and restored) and accepted R47; frame inspection of gesture timing.
data.scope: Whether a picture offset or skipping restoration could repair part C.
data.limitations: Correlations are weak and inconsistent across takes (C restored best 0.195 at -2 frames, native 0.165; A 0.37; R47 0.28), so no reliable offset fix. The open-hand gesture lands around 'about half the time' rather than 'not yours to pick'. Heuristic only; not a perceptual verdict.

data.choice: Regenerate part C with lip sync prioritized, steady head, hands at rest until 'not yours to pick', one small palm-up then rest; same audio media and references; one 90-credit take plus one Fal restoration.
